fixtures.data: exact integer id and payloads; numeric-64 uses 63 modulo-1024 payload fields; text-1024 uses 1024 ASCII x bytes
fixtures.lowSelectivity: scan N rows and every declared field, retain the final two ids
fixtures.join: two copies of every id on each side: N input rows, 2*N intermediate pairs, one global count row
fixtures.reuse: N rows and all fields survive capture, A/B branches and A-to-C consumption
fixtures.ceilings: per-case limits emitted by the pinned generator; distinct source/intermediate rows and cumulative value/work/representation caps
fixtures.failureTreatment: timeout, unsupported required profile or budget rejection is incomplete/failing, never an omitted sample

scope: local process-owned task completion, independent holding, downstream consumption and cleanup; not formal Run/Result publication
notes: Concrete deterministic fixtures, input/intermediate/output cardinalities, resource ceilings and timeout must be frozen before performance samples.
No thresholds are inferred from historical Local layout measurements.
Measure actual traffic, hash bytes/passes, materializations, process memory and ledger units separately.
Correctness includes all currently admitted types, identity/order/NULL/duplicate parity, tamper, ownership, expiry, cancellation and cleanup failures.
Process-local file retention does not establish recovery after control Host restart.
